EmailTemplate.subject: Thank you for requesting our free First-Aid Kit
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
The Emergency Experts - OrlandoHealthER.com
Thank you for submitting your request to receive your free First-Aid Kit from Orlando Health, The Emergency Experts.
Your First-Aid Kit should arrive within 4-6 weeks.
Supplies are limited, one request per household. Submission of the request form does not guarantee fulfillment.
